description: This file defines the Fido2ApiPackage class, which implements the ReactPackage interface to provide native modules for React Native integration, specifically setting up the Fido2ApiModule.

classes.name: Fido2ApiPackage
classes.description: Implements ReactPackage to provide native modules and view managers for React Native.

methods.name: createViewManagers
methods.description: Returns an empty list of view managers, indicating no custom UI components are provided.

methods.name: createNativeModules
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of native modules, including the Fido2ApiModule.
